author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu, we see the return of the Razor Crest, the bounty hunting spaceship dramatically destroyed in season 2 of The Mandalorian. It’s another opportunity for Jon Favreau and his creative collaborators to film this beloved vessel in miniature scale, and a chance for Adam Savage to walk aboard the fully fleshed out practical set of the Razor Crest flight deck. 

Note: This video is not sponsored. 
Adam Savage Behind the Scenes of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ijk4XMe7n_c

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
